Definition: properly, to lurk for, i.e. persecute
BiblicalUsage: Satam is hating, lying in wait, and it runs through the story of two brothers. Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing, and said in his heart he would slay his brother when the days of mourning for his father were at hand. And Joseph's brothers did the same to him — the archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that hatred kept in the heart always moves toward the hand: Esau's hatred became a plan to kill, and Joseph's brothers' hatred became a pit and a sale.
RelatedPeople: Jacob; Esau; Joseph, Son of Jacob
